Quote of the Day

Start your day with inspiration — 65 original motivational quotes, with a date-seeded “today's quote” plus shuffle.

📖 How to use

  1. See today's date-seeded quote automatically.
  2. Press Shuffle for a new random quote.
  3. Press Show 10 to browse more; click any to copy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are these famous quotes?

65 original motivational quotes written for this tool — no copied celebrity quotes.

How does “today's quote” work?

The same quote is shown all day based on the date, so it works like a daily quote calendar — and everyone sees the same one.

Can I get a random quote too?

Yes — press Shuffle for a random quote any time, or browse 10 at once.
